_comment: Serving shim candidate for vLLM (serving-probe 2026-11-13). Only needed if vLLM's own hy_v4 config path (vllm.transformers_utils.configs.hy_v4) is not used: AutoConfig in the image (transformers 5.12.1) does not know hy_v4. Llama-shaped, dims from /mnt/tt-data/Hy4-Preview/config.json. num_key_value_heads=1/head_dim=576 (kv_lora_rank 512 + qk_rope_head_dim 64) is accounting only (U): the TT model owns its KV pool. Tokenizer and chat template come from the checkpoint (--tokenizer). No quantization_config.
